attacks.name: Myriad Snare: Rustfire Chassis - Echo Skill 1
attacks.sourceText:
Summon Myriad Snare: Rustfire Chassis, dealing Fusion DMG equal to 5.67% of the Max HP on initial impact. During its duration, it repeatedly crushes enemies along its path up to 19 times, dealing Fusion DMG equal to 0.20% of the Max HP each time.
Resonators with this Echo equipped in the main slot gain 12.00% Fusion DMG Bonus and 12.00% Heavy Attack DMG Bonus.
